output_format: Index of first unique character or -1.

Iterate through the string a second time.
Return the index of the first character with a count of 1.

reference_solution:
import sys
s = sys.stdin.read().rstrip('\r\n')
from collections import Counter
counts = Counter(s)
ans = -1
for i, c in enumerate(s):
    if counts[c] == 1:
        ans = i
        break
print(ans)
